office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Andrew Biviano is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County District Court judge since 2023, a former federal prosecutor and private-practice attorney; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Assistant U.S. Attorney 2006-2012, then private practice 2012-2023 [S1]
Former mental health case manager; stresses a fair, accessible and dignified court process [S1]
